E-S_L1.rule: best selection score of the top-3
E-S_L1.source:
def h0:
  union P3 P3 P4
  union P0 P0 P2
  dedupe P1 P1
  union P0 P0 P3
def h1:
def h0b:
  union P3 P3 P4
  union P0 P0 P2
  dedupe P1 P1
  union P0 P0 P3
def h1b:
  lits P3 [3, 7]
def h4:
  combine P4 P0 P4 *
def h0bb:
  union P3 P3 P4
  dedupe P1 P1
  union P4 P0 P3
def h1bb:
  dedupe P3 P3
  if n_obs_int_frac < 0.5:
    repeat 3:
      if n_trans < 10:
        combine P4 P0 P4 *
        combine P0 P2 P1 *
      else:
        union P3 P5 P4
main:
  terms P0 ['acc', 'x']
  if n_trans < 15:
    call h0
    dedupe P3 P0
  else:
    repeat 3:
      combine P3 P3 P5 +
      repeat 2:
        combine P5 P2 P3 +
        if n_trans < 10:
          union P4 P5 P5
  lits P1 [0, 1]
  union P0 P0 P1
  combine P0 P0 P1 +
  combine P3 P0 P0 -
  union P2 P2 P3
  combine P3 P2 P0 +
  combine P4 P2 P0 -
  union P3 P3 P4
  combine P4 P0 P2 +
  combine P5 P0 P2 -
  union P4 P4 P5
  call h0
  dedupe P0 P0
  union P3 P3 P4
  combine P4 P0 P2 +
  combine P5 P0 P2 -
  union P4 P4 P5
  call h0
  dedupe P0 P0
  call h0
  dedupe P0 P0
  sort P0 P0 size
  ret P0
